blocks.title: Selection sort
blocks.text: Selection Sort finds the smallest (or largest) element in the unsorted part of the list and swaps it with the first unsorted element, moving the boundary between sorted and unsorted parts by one each time.
Selection Sort is O(n^2); like Bubble Sort it is not efficient for large datasets but is straightforward to implement.
